_comentario: Assets madre: hojas de modelo y locaciones. Se generan una vez y son la referencia de todos los fotogramas.

assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic photograph of an old white-and-red stone lighthouse on a black rock islet in a violent night storm, vertical frame. Huge waves exploding against the rocks, rain streaking sideways, low storm cloud. The lamp room at the top glows weak warm amber through its glass. A single steel door at the base, lit by one caged work light. No people, no boats. Film grain, deep blacks, wet surfaces shining. This is a single film frame, not a poster: no text, no borders, no titles, no watermark.
